description: This is a database migration script for the Superset project, specifically adding granularity parameters to chart configurations missing them, to support proper time range filtering.

classes.name: Slice
classes.description: Represents a chart slice with parameters and datasource info.

classes.name: SqlaTable
classes.description: Represents a SQLAlchemy table with optional main datetime column.

classes.name: TableColumn
classes.description: Represents a column in a table, indicating if it is a datetime column.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Adds granularity parameter to chart slices missing it, based on dataset's main datetime column or first datetime column found.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: No downgrade implementation; migration is irreversible.
